title: Wonderful!
text: Wonderful!. This is a wonderful Christmas decoration. I have collected of few of these and have them on my mantle for the holiday season. They make me very happy to see them. This one is unique with its red barn exterior. The 6 hour timer is convenient.

product_metadata.title: DRomance Christmas Music Snow Globe Lantern with 6 Hour Timer, USB Powered Battery Operated Lighted Water Singing Snow Globe Holiday Women Children Gift(Nativity, 5 x 3.1 x 11.1 Inches)
features: ❤Musical Snow Globe for Christmas Gifts: Our singing snow globe lantern light up with colourful glitters swirling and water spinning around the Snowman, gorgeous and attractive looking. A lovely Christmas gift for yourself or someone special

❤Music and Timer Feature: There is a 3-way switch at the bottom, Music/OFF/Timer. Slide switch to Music, lantern will light up and cycle playing the music. Slide switch to Timer, lantern will light up without music for 6 hours then automatically turn off. Once the timer set, cycle every 24 hours

❤Power Supply: Included USB cable allows you operate the snow globe lantern without batteries. You can also operate it with 3 AA batteries (not included), so that you can place them anywhere you want to display with your Christmas decorations

❤Well Designed and Well Constructed: Unique frame snow globe with palm tree figurine inside, high quality plastic promising long-time durability. You can use them as a centerpiece decoration for a whole winter

❤Satisfaction guarantee: Each snow globe is thoroughly tested before leaving the factory, if any problems occurs to our product, please kindly contact our customer support and we will offer you a satisfactory solution
